scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/operator-dashboard install && npm --prefix apps/admin-dashboard install
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && concurrently -k -n backend,operator,admin -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run backend:dev" "npm run operator:dev" "npm run admin:dev"
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.cluster:logs: docker compose --profile cluster logs -f nginx backend-1 backend-2
scripts.cluster:reset: docker compose --profile cluster down -v && docker compose --profile cluster up -d --wait --build
